title: Require clean-state exit before handoff
narrative: A run is not done until checkpoint durability, pending-node policy, and optional handoff records satisfy a clean-state exit contract. Accepts WalkingLabs L12 guidance[^wl-l12-exit].
implementation: `CleanStateContract` / `ExitContract` and `evaluate_exit` in `mechaharness.exit_contract` check post-run clean-state invariants.
validation: Harness `pure_api` op `exit_clean_state`. Soft expects ok true.
